ChemLab instrument benchmark: human validity review

Review one case at a time. Judge the stated simulator task and the information available to the agent. Instrument expertise helps identify unclear wording, implausible faults and unsupported answers. This review does not certify real equipment or chemical outcomes.

First record an independent answer and ratings. The reference answers are absent from this file. Reference comparison is optional until you load the separate local key; once a case is unblinded, its original independent answer is locked. Download your progress regularly. Nothing is uploaded.

Reviewer and date apply when you edit a case. A blank answer is never turned into approval. Browser storage may be unavailable for local files or private browsing; the downloaded JSON preserves locks and revision history.
